mapper.insert: INSERT INTO op_comparison_analysis ( id, incident_id, operational_period_ids, request_hash, source_data_hash, status, metrics_json, diff_facts_json, common_regions_geojson, narrative_status, observations_json, failure_reason, requested_by_account_id, requested_at, generated_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{record.id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{record.incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{record.operationalPeriodIdsJson}::jsonb, #{record.requestHash}, #{record.sourceDataHash}, #{record.status}, #{record.metricsJson}::jsonb, #{record.diffFactsJson}::jsonb, #{record.commonRegionsGeojson}::jsonb, #{record.narrativeStatus}, #{record.observationsJson}::jsonb, #{record.failureReason}, #{record.requestedByAccountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{record.requestedAt}, #{record.generatedAt}, #{record.version}, #{record.createdAt}, #{record.updatedAt} )

UPDATE op_comparison_analysis SET status = #{status}, narrative_status = #{narrativeStatus}, observations_json = #{observationsJson}::jsonb, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, generated_at = #{generatedAt}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
